recent.text: Obviously, the Flyers can try to try and mend fences, show Michkov he's valued, make moves to appease him and his camp. But there is still a possible scenario where he still wants a fresh start no matter what. Seems like everyone is just assuming that the Flyers can fix this.
recent.author: Gus Elvin
recent.quoted_text: Regarding the Michkov situation, a lot of the national reports are hammering home that the Flyers have made it clear he's "their guy" and they are going to make it work, which is expected, especially on heels of Gauthier. But ultimately, this comes down to what MM wants.
